violation_type.title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §747.5107(a))
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation was not conducting monthly fire extinguisher inspections.

finding_variants.text: The operation was not conducting monthly fire extinguisher inspections.
The carbon monoxide detector, smoke detector, and fire extinguisher were not being checked monthly. In February 2024, this equipment was not checked by the primary caregiver.
The permit holder has not completed monthly inspections of the fire extinguishers.
The fire extinguisher has not been inspected each month.
The operation did not have documentation showing fire extinguishers were checked monthly.
The fire extinguisher inspections are not documented for the 2025 calendar year.
